eps.t: Analysis vs. Instinct in Hamburg, Germany
eps.o: An intuitive woman knew Hamburg was home within 20 minutes, but her analytical husband researched all of Germany before reaching the same conclusion. With their two young boys in tow, they're now searching for a home that fits their cultural adventure.

A military move has landed a Naval Chief and his wife in Cádiz Province, Spain. She's working from home and is willing to spend more for a place with historic charm, but he prefers to stay in their budget with something new and affordable.

eps.t: London Artist Takes On the Australian Outback
eps.o: A British artist looks to focus on growing her art tour business and permanently relocate to Alice Springs, Australia. She's looking for a big block of land with nature views to run workshops, but her dream property may not match the size of her budget.

eps.t: From Seattle Showers to Okinawa Shores
eps.o: a couple relocating from Seattle to Okinawa, Japan, balancing a beachside dream with the need for walkability and affordability.

A Texas family once moved to Australia with toddlers, and now they're returning with teenagers to Brisbane. They're looking for a place that's near public transportation, and he wants a big backyard, but she doesn't mind spending for an ideal location.

eps.t: Big Dreams on a New Pitch in Nottingham
eps.o: After months of moving across Europe, a family looks to put down roots in Nottingham, England. With a dream job, a new stay-at-home parent, and a child who's spent half his life on the road, they need to find a home that truly fits everyone's needs.

eps.t: Follow Your Muse to Puerto Morelos, Mexico
eps.o: A less-traveled boyfriend is inspired by his more worldly partner to move from Denver to Puerto Morelos, Mexico. They want outdoor space for their pets, and she doesn't mind paying to be near the beach, but he's budget minded and prefers to spend less.

eps.t: Sold It All for Balestrate, Italy
eps.o: Empty nesters sell everything and leave Missouri to explore his Sicilian roots in Balestrate, Italy. They want something furnished that has a terrace with sea views, but they may have to make some compromises to find a place fast and in their budget.

eps.t: Cheeky Brits in Alice Springs, Australia
eps.o: Priced out of Cambridge, England, a British couple looks for their first home together in Alice Springs, Australia. They're both seeking a quieter life, and he wants something remote on the outskirts, but she prefers a place that's closer to town.

A mother and daughter duo are ready to ditch Nashville to chase a dream in Les 7 Vallees, France. Mom wants traditional French charm and doesn't mind projects, but her daughter prefers something modern that's turnkey.

After eight years together in Montreal, a creative couple looks to refocus on growing their art abroad in Copenhagen, Denmark. They're looking for a modern apartment near the city center, but with a small budget, they may need to compromise on location.

eps.t: A Family Fight in Mexico's Yucatán
eps.o: A family gives up their semi-nomadic life of travel to plant roots in Mexico's Yucatán. He dreams of a quiet beach life while mom and daughter prefer to be closer to the city, so they may struggle to find a place where no one has to settle.

eps.t: From Seattle Showers to Okinawa Shores
eps.o: A couple leaves dreary Seattle for a lifelong dream to live on a beachy island in Okinawa, Japan. She wants to be close to the beach while he prefers something walkable near town, but on one income, finding everything they both want may be a challenge.
